notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
We are coming close to the end of Initial Game development. We want to thank everyone for helping us with closed beta testing! Our Launch date is set for February 25, 2025 (Midnight release).

Our meetings have been long, late and very interesting for Eternal Halls. The "polishing" process has been quite the task and and we are doing our best to offer everyone a good experience for players of all skill ranges. We want to onboard new gamers and experienced gamers all equally, with the goal in mind that player interests are met from all angles and directions.

We will be releasing a new trailer and new photos before the initial launch of the game, for everyone to look over and use this to decide about game purchasing. There are new things added to the game after the last trailer and we are looking forward to showcasing the final product. 

Thank you!

-Eternal Halls staff.

notes.title: Nearly finished
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Eternal Halls is nearly completed. It has been an amazing  journey! We are all very proud of this game and how much work has gone into it. We want to thank our beta testers for giving us solid feedback!

Eternal Halls is going to offer amazing gameplay with a nice "call back" to the Retro style PC and arcade  games of the 90s that inspired us to be where we are at today! With newer graphics models and designs. Eternal Halls brings the 90s style game to 2025! Here is to a great year and we hope you like the game!

Information on the release:

- 5 different map sizes featured in the Options menu prior to starting a match.

- Enemy and "no enemy" mode - perfect to learn the game at your pace or to "amp up" the danger.

- 3 Spells and abilities for players to use in order  to hinder the eternal Guardians. 

- Enhanced "map zoom" during gameplay by pressing "m". 

- Some changes to help with color blind issues (in the works). 



Potential Future of the game roadmap (To be decided):

- We are going to be working with wall maps and textures to add in additional map elements to the game. 

- Potential "boss encounter" mode for the most dedicated adventurers. 


 more changes in the works. Please check back for updates!


Thank you!

       - Eternal halls Staff.
